boundary.label: Early firmware only. Product acceptance remains unverified.
boundary.detail: The latest real-media boot stops during firmware initialization. Metal clients cross-build; utility planning and read-only inspection run in an internal OVMF research profile. No verified macOS 27 installation, working Metal driver or qualified real Intel Mac is available.

milestones.title: Reach early firmware
milestones.summary: Real macOS 27 media reaches an early firmware stage, then stops during initialization. The current real-media result is firmware-stage execution only.
milestones.observed: Early firmware execution has been observed. This does not establish macOS kernel or userspace startup.
milestones.next: Resolve the initialization failure and demonstrate a repeatable transition to the target macOS kernel.

milestones.title: Start macOS and reach a desktop
milestones.summary: No verified macOS 27 kernel-to-userspace boot, installed-system reboot or interactive desktop on a real Intel Mac is available.
milestones.observed: Earlier experiments and authored tests cover individual components. They do not satisfy the current macOS 27 acceptance target.
milestones.next: Verify the target OS version, kernel and userspace in one boot, followed by installation, reboot and visible interaction on identified real hardware.
milestones.acceptance: Boot and physical desktop acceptance are false.

milestones.title: Run Metal work in the guest
milestones.summary: Metal test clients cross-build successfully. Those clients are prerequisites for testing; they are not a working graphics driver.
milestones.observed: Client builds and contract checks exist. A guest-visible Metal provider connected to a functioning driver has not been demonstrated.
milestones.next: Create an actual guest Metal device and command queue, submit work, observe completion and verify rendered or computed results.
milestones.acceptance: Metal acceptance is false. No performance target is required.

milestones.title: Inspect a disk and review a plan
milestones.summary: The internal utility exercises explicit target selection, planning and read-only GPT inspection under OVMF with 512-byte and 4096-byte sectors.
milestones.observed: Read-only firmware checks and 36 EFI core tests cover this increment. Planning review, cancellation and inspection do not install anything.
milestones.next: Connect the reviewed plan to independently verified firmware operations while preserving exact target identity and unrelated disks.
milestones.acceptance: The public default release-policy preview is non-installing. Internal research results do not qualify its use on hardware.

milestones.title: Apply and verify an installation
milestones.summary: 37 host tests pass for disposable disk-image creation and transaction handling. They exercise host tools, not physical disk installation from EFI.
milestones.observed: Disposable-image tests cover bounded writes, verification and transaction recovery checks. EFI runtime apply and installed-system recovery remain unfinished.
milestones.next: Implement exact-target confirmation, firmware writes, readback, interruption handling and applicable boot-entry setup; qualify Recovery and DFU separately where the hardware supports them.
milestones.acceptance: Installation, Recovery and DFU acceptance are false.

milestones.title: Qualify real Intel Mac hardware
milestones.summary: No real Intel Mac has completed product qualification. There is no supported model list for this preview.
milestones.observed: The exact downloadable preview ISO entered the default release-policy utility under QEMU/OVMF and refused the virtual machine without disk or NVRAM writes. A VM refusal test does not establish reliable real-Mac authentication.
milestones.next: Validate admission and each claimed operation on identified real Intel Macs, including negative controls, installation, reboot and usable output.
milestones.acceptance: Real-hardware qualification is false. Model strings alone are not proof of Apple hardware.

metrics.label: Real Intel Macs qualified
metrics.detail: No model is approved for installation or supported runtime use.

metrics.label: Disposable-image host tests
metrics.detail: Host-side transaction and writer checks; no physical installation claim.

metrics.label: EFI core tests
metrics.detail: Core behavior checks; no macOS, Metal or hardware acceptance claim.

latest.title: Installation utility: inspect and plan
latest.summary: Read-only GPT inspection and target planning are tested in OVMF for 512-byte and 4096-byte sectors. Physical installation remains unverified.

latest.title: Metal: client builds are a prerequisite
latest.summary: Actual test-client cross-builds pass. Guest device creation, command submission and correct output still require a working driver and execution evidence.

latest.title: Engineering preview publication target
latest.summary: The ISO and EFI use the default release-policy build, with channel preview. They contain no macOS payload and do not establish OS bootability.
